ValidationRule.description: If Status is "Active", Resigned Date & Relieving Date should be blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Active"), OR( NOT(ISBLANK( Date_of_Resignation__c )), NOT(ISBLANK(Relieving_Date__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Resignation Date and Relieving Date must be blank when status is Active
